accessibilityHint.description: Helps users understand what will happen when they perform an action

accessibilityLabel.description: VoiceOver will read this string when a user selects the element

clearable.description:
Add a clear action on the input that clears the value.

Since the input value isn't editable (i.e. `InputDateTime`) you can
set it to `always`. If you set it to `always` you must also provide an
onClear to clear the input's value

error.description: Indicates if there is an validation error

focused.description: Indicates if the input is focused

invalid.description: Indicates the current selection is invalid

onClear.description:
Callback called when the user clicks the ClearAction button. Should clear
the value passed. To disallow clearing set the clearable prop to never

onPress.description:
Callback that is called when the text input is focused
@param event

placeholder.description: Placeholder item shown until a selection is made

prefix.description: Symbol to display before the text input

showMiniLabel.description:
Controls the visibility of the mini label that appears inside the input
when a value is entered. By default, the placeholder text moves up to
become a mini label. Set to false to disable this behavior.

suffix.description: Symbol to display after the text input

type.name: { icon: IconNames; label?: string; onPress: () => void; } | { onPress?: never; icon?: IconNames; label?: string; }
